title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.30376v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent, attention-free sequence models share a structural weakness: a fading state cannot perform exact recall of something seen once, far in the past. We add to the Kathleen trunk a second memory layer -- a "notebook": a fixed-key holographic (HRR) associative store with a learned local write gate, a self-gating raw read, and write-triggered forgetting -- 25K parameters that attach to the logits of any trunk. (1) Mechanism: on a controlled needle-in-haystack task the notebook reaches 80-82% one-shot recall at 4x the training length, where the bare trunk scores ~4% and a parameter-matched attention head scores 100% inside its training length and 0% beyond it. Addressing is length-invariant by construction; the untrained memory alone recalls at 90% accuracy identically at 512, 2048 and 4096 bytes. translated_title: Kathleen的记忆：无需注意力机制的长度不变单次召回
translated_abstract: 循环的、无注意力的序列模型存在一个结构性弱点：不断衰减的状态无法精确回忆起很久之前只见过一次的内容。我们在Kathleen主干网络上添加了第二个记忆层——一个“笔记本”：一个固定密钥的全息（HRR）联想存储器，具有可学习的局部写入门控、自门控的原始读取以及写入触发的遗忘机制——仅25K参数，可附加到任何主干网络的logits上。（1）机制：在受控的“大海捞针”任务中，笔记本在4倍训练长度下达到80-82%的单次召回率，而裸主干网络仅得约4%，参数量匹配的注意力头在其训练长度内得100%，超出后则为0%。其寻址在构造上就是长度不变的；未经训练的存储器单独在512、2048和4096字节下均能以相同的90%准确率进行召回。由于该存储是线性叠加的，两种能力仅凭算术运算即可获得：选择性遗忘（一次减法即可擦除一个
tldr: 该论文为无注意力的循环模型附加一个仅25K参数的固定密钥全息（HRR）“笔记本”记忆层，实现了长度不变的单次精确回忆——在4倍训练长度下召回率达80-82%——并凭线性叠加性质仅用简单算术即可实现选择性遗忘等能力。
en_tdlr: The paper attaches a 25K-parameter fixed-key holographic (HRR) "notebook" memory to attention-free recurrent trunks, achieving length-invariant one-shot exact recall (80-82% at 4x the training length), with capabilities like selective unlearning arising directly from linear superposition arithmetic.
